title: 1 Timothy Chapter 4 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Timothy chapter 4 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Timothy Chapter 4 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Timothy Chapter 4.

questions.question: In 1 Timothy 4, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Some shall depart from the faith
Every creature of God is good
Thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Some shall depart from the faith
questions.explanation: The first event mentioned is 'some shall depart from the faith' in 1 Timothy 4:1, which appears before the other options.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:1, who speaks expressly about the latter times?
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 states that 'Now the Spirit speaketh expressly' about the latter times.

questions.question: What will some do in the latter times according to 1 Timothy 4:1?
questions.correctAnswer: Depart from the faith
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 says 'some shall depart from the faith' in the latter times.

questions.question: Who do the doctrines come from that some will give heed to, according to 1 Timothy 4:1?
questions.correctAnswer: Devils
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 mentions 'doctrines of devils' that some will follow.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:2, what is said to be seared with a hot iron?
questions.correctAnswer: Their conscience
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:2 states 'having their conscience seared with a hot iron'.

questions.question: What kind of speech do those mentioned in 1 Timothy 4:2 use?
questions.correctAnswer: Lies in hypocrisy
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:2 says they are 'Speaking lies in hypocrisy'.

questions.question: What do some forbid according to 1 Timothy 4:3?
questions.correctAnswer: To marry
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 states 'Forbidding to marry'.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:3, what do some command to abstain from?
questions.correctAnswer: Meats
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 mentions 'commanding to abstain from meats'.

questions.question: Who created the meats that some command to abstain from, according to 1 Timothy 4:3?
questions.correctAnswer: God
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 says 'which God hath created'.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:4, what is said about every creature of God?
options: It is good and nothing to be refused
questions.correctAnswer: It is good and nothing to be refused
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:4 states 'For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused'.

questions.question: What sanctifies food, according to 1 Timothy 4:5?
options: The word of God and prayer
questions.correctAnswer: The word of God and prayer
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:5 says 'For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer'.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Timothy 4:6 says that putting brethren in remembrance of these things makes a good minister of Jesus Christ.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:6 states 'If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ'.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Timothy 4:6, a good minister is nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:6 says a good minister is 'nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine'.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Timothy 4:3 commands believers to fast every day.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 mentions forbidding marriage and abstaining from meats, but does not command fasting every day.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Timothy 4:2 says that those who speak lies have a pure conscience.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:2 says they have their conscience seared with a hot iron, not pure.

medium.title: 1 Timothy Chapter 4 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Timothy Chapter 4 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:7, what should believers refuse and instead exercise themselves unto?
questions.correctAnswer: Profane and old wives' fables
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:7 instructs believers to refuse profane and old wives' fables and to exercise themselves rather unto godliness.

questions.question: What does 1 Timothy 4:8 promise will happen if someone exercises themselves unto godliness as commanded in 1 Timothy 4:7?
options: Godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of this life and that which is to come
They will gain physical strength and wealth
They will be free from all troubles
They will be recognized by all men
questions.correctAnswer: Godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of this life and that which is to come
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:8 explains that godliness is profitable unto all things and has the promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come, directly following the command in verse 7.

questions.question: What is described as 'a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation' in 1 Timothy 4:9?
questions.correctAnswer: The profit of godliness
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:9 states that the saying about godliness being profitable unto all things is faithful and worthy of all acceptation.

questions.question: How are 1 Timothy 4:11 and 1 Timothy 4:12 connected in their instructions to Timothy?
options: Verse 11 commands teaching, and verse 12 instructs on being an example in conduct
Verse 11 commands fasting, and verse 12 instructs on praying
Verse 11 warns against false doctrine, and verse 12 instructs on charity
Verse 11 explains faith, and verse 12 explains purity
questions.correctAnswer: Verse 11 commands teaching, and verse 12 instructs on being an example in conduct
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:11 commands Timothy to teach certain things, and 1 Timothy 4:12 tells him to be an example in word and conduct, connecting command and example.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:10, why do believers labor and suffer reproach?
options: Because they trust in the living God who is the Saviour of all men
Because they want to gain wealth
Because they follow strict dietary rules
questions.correctAnswer: Because they trust in the living God who is the Saviour of all men
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:10 explains that believers labor and suffer reproach because they trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men.

questions.question: What specific areas does 1 Timothy 4:12 say Timothy should be an example in?
options: Word, conversation, charity, spirit, faith, purity
questions.correctAnswer: Word, conversation, charity, spirit, faith, purity
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12 instructs Timothy to be an example in word, conversation, charity, spirit, faith, and purity.

questions.question: What does 1 Timothy 4:4 say about 'every creature of God'?
options: It is good and nothing is to be refused if received with thanksgiving
It should be avoided to maintain purity
It is unclean and must be rejected
questions.correctAnswer: It is good and nothing is to be refused if received with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:4 clearly states that every creature of God is good and nothing is to be refused if received with thanksgiving.

questions.question: What does 1 Timothy 4:5 say sanctifies food received with thanksgiving?
options: The word of God and prayer
questions.correctAnswer: The word of God and prayer
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:5 explains that food is sanctified by the word of God and prayer when received with thanksgiving.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:1-2, what characterizes those who depart from the faith in latter times?
options: They give heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils, speaking lies in hypocrisy
They increase in love and charity
questions.correctAnswer: They give heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils, speaking lies in hypocrisy
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1-2 describes those departing from the faith as giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils, speaking lies in hypocrisy.

questions.question: What is Timothy encouraged to do in 1 Timothy 4:6 to be a good minister of Jesus Christ?
options: Put the brethren in remembrance of the truths about faith and good doctrine
questions.correctAnswer: Put the brethren in remembrance of the truths about faith and good doctrine
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:6 encourages Timothy to remind brethren of faith and good doctrine to be a good minister of Jesus Christ.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:3, what false commands do some teach that depart from the faith?
options: Forbidding to marry and commanding to abstain from meats
questions.correctAnswer: Forbidding to marry and commanding to abstain from meats
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 identifies false teachers forbidding marriage and commanding abstinence from meats as part of their doctrines.

questions.question: What does 1 Timothy 4:7 say about the value of physical exercise compared to godliness?
options: Physical exercise profits little, godliness profits all things
Physical exercise profits more than godliness
Physical exercise and godliness are equally profitable
questions.correctAnswer: Physical exercise profits little, godliness profits all things
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:8 states that bodily exercise profits little, but godliness is profitable unto all things.

questions.question: Why does 1 Timothy 4:10 say God is specially the Saviour of those who believe?
options: Because believers have trust in the living God
Because believers keep the law perfectly
questions.correctAnswer: Because believers have trust in the living God
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:10 explains that God is the Saviour of all men, especially of those who believe, because they trust in Him.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Timothy 4:12 encourages Timothy to be an example of believers only in faith and purity.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12 instructs Timothy to be an example in word, conversation, charity, spirit, faith, and purity, not only faith and purity.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Timothy 4:1, the Spirit says some will depart from the faith in latter times.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 states that the Spirit speaks expressly that in latter times some shall depart from the faith.

hard.title: 1 Timothy Chapter 4 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Timothy Chapter 4.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:13, what three activities should Timothy give attendance to until Paul comes?
questions.correctAnswer: Reading, exhortation, doctrine
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:13 instructs Timothy to give attendance to reading, exhortation, and doctrine until Paul comes.

questions.question: In 1 Timothy 4:14, what is Timothy specifically told not to neglect?
options: The gift that is in thee
questions.correctAnswer: The gift that is in thee
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:14 exhorts Timothy not to neglect the gift that is in him, which was given by prophecy and the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

questions.question: What does 1 Timothy 4:15 say Timothy should do with the teachings he receives?
options: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them
Write them down and share with elders
questions.correctAnswer: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:15 commands Timothy to meditate on these things and give himself wholly to them so that his profiting may appear to all.

questions.question: What dual benefit is promised in 1 Timothy 4:16 if Timothy takes heed to himself and to the doctrine?
options: He shall save himself and them that hear him
He will gain wealth and fame
He will become a great leader
He will receive visions and dreams
questions.correctAnswer: He shall save himself and them that hear him
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:16 states that by continuing in taking heed to himself and to the doctrine, Timothy will save both himself and those who hear him.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:13, which of the following is NOT included as something Timothy should focus on?
questions.correctAnswer: Prophecy
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:13 lists reading, exhortation, and doctrine as the focus; prophecy is mentioned in verse 14 but not in verse 13.

questions.question: In 1 Timothy 4:14, how was the gift given to Timothy?
options: By prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery
questions.correctAnswer: By prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:14 states that the gift was given by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery, indicating a formal ecclesiastical act.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'paraklesis' (παράκλησις) in 1 Timothy 4:13 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Exhortation or encouragement
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'paraklesis' used in 1 Timothy 4:13 means exhortation or encouragement, fitting the context of urging Timothy to attend to teaching and encouragement.

questions.question: Which literary device best describes the structure of 1 Timothy 4:13-16, focusing on personal responsibility and teaching duties?
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:13-16 forms an inclusio by framing Timothy’s duties with attention to reading, exhortation, doctrine, and taking heed to himself and the doctrine, highlighting a thematic enclosure.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage echoes the theme of meditating on God's word as found in 1 Timothy 4:15?
questions.correctAnswer: Psalm 1:2
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:2 speaks about delighting in the law of the Lord and meditating on it day and night, paralleling the instruction in 1 Timothy 4:15 to meditate upon the teachings.

questions.question: The warning about 'departing from the faith' and 'doctrines of devils' in 1 Timothy 4:1 connects closely with which New Testament passage?
questions.correctAnswer: 2 Timothy 3:13
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:13 warns that evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived, which connects to the warning in 1 Timothy 4:1 about departing from the faith and following deceiving spirits.

questions.question: What immediately precedes the instructions about giving attendance to reading, exhortation, and doctrine in 1 Timothy 4:13?
options: Let no man despise thy youth
If thou put the brethren in remembrance
questions.correctAnswer: Let no man despise thy youth
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12, which immediately precedes verse 13, instructs Timothy not to let anyone despise his youth and to be an example in various virtues.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:7-8, what is considered profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come?
questions.correctAnswer: Godliness
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:8 contrasts bodily exercise with godliness, stating godliness is profitable in all things with promise for this life and the life to come.

questions.question: What is the historical-cultural significance of 'the laying on of the hands of the presbytery' mentioned in 1 Timothy 4:14?
options: It was the recognized rite of commissioning elders or ministers in early church practice
It was a pagan ritual adopted by the church
It referred to a Roman governmental approval
It was a symbolic gesture with no real authority
questions.correctAnswer: It was the recognized rite of commissioning elders or ministers in early church practice
questions.explanation: The laying on of hands by the presbytery was an established Jewish and early Christian practice for commissioning leaders, indicating spiritual empowerment and official appointment, as seen in 1 Timothy 4:14.

questions.question: From a typological perspective, the warning in 1 Timothy 4:3 against forbidding marriage and abstaining from meats foreshadows which New Testament issue?
options: The Judaizers’ legalism confronted in Acts and Galatians
The prohibition of idol worship in Revelation
The dietary laws abolished by Jesus in Mark
The Sabbath observance disputes in Hebrews
questions.correctAnswer: The Judaizers’ legalism confronted in Acts and Galatians
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3's warning about forbidding marriage and foods connects typologically to the Judaizers’ legalistic teachings addressed in Acts 15 and Paul's epistle to the Galatians.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Timothy 4:16 teaches that continuing in doctrine will result only in the salvation of others, not oneself.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:16 clearly states that continuing in doctrine will save both the individual (Timothy) and those who hear him, not only others.

theological.title: 1 Timothy Chapter 4 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Timothy Chapter 4 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Timothy 4:1 teach about human sin?
options: Some will depart from the faith due to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils
All will remain steadfast in faith until the return of Christ
Sin originates only from external sources, not internal rebellion
Sinning is inevitable and cannot be resisted by believers
questions.correctAnswer: Some will depart from the faith due to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 explicitly states that in latter times some will depart from the faith by giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils, indicating apostasy caused by false teachings.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 Timothy 4:3 teach regarding God's creation and Christian liberty?
options: God created meats to be received with thanksgiving by believers who know the truth
Believers must abstain from all meats to be holy
Marriage is forbidden for Christians to attain holiness
All created things are inherently evil and should be avoided
questions.correctAnswer: God created meats to be received with thanksgiving by believers who know the truth
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:3 teaches that forbidding marriage and abstaining from meats contradicts the truth that God created these to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

questions.question: What doctrine about sanctification is taught in 1 Timothy 4:5?
options: Sanctification of food comes through the word of God and prayer
Sanctification is only a future event after death
Sanctification is achieved by strict adherence to dietary laws
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctification of food comes through the word of God and prayer
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:5 states that everything created by God is sanctified by the word of God and prayer, indicating the means by which created things are set apart.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 Timothy 4:10 specifically demonstrate?
options: Sovereignty in salvation as the Saviour of all men
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty in salvation as the Saviour of all men
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:10 shows God's role as the living God and Saviour of all men, especially believers, demonstrating His sovereign power over salvation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted by 1 Timothy 4:1 regarding false teaching?
options: Justice in punishing false teachers immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience in forewarning about apostasy
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:1 demonstrates God's omniscience as the Spirit expressly speaks about future apostasy, showing God’s foreknowledge of events.

questions.question: How does 1 Timothy 4 connect to the broader biblical theme of perseverance in faith?
options: By instructing Timothy to continue in doctrine and self-care to save himself and hearers
By teaching that perseverance is unnecessary due to predestination
By focusing solely on external rites without internal transformation
By encouraging abandonment of faith in the face of trials
questions.correctAnswer: By instructing Timothy to continue in doctrine and self-care to save himself and hearers
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:16 commands Timothy to take heed to himself and doctrine, continuing in them to save both himself and those who hear him, emphasizing perseverance consistent with Hebrews 3:14.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does 1 Timothy 4:12 make concerning Christian witness?
options: Youthful believers must be examples in all aspects of faith and conduct
Only elders are responsible for moral examples in the church
Faith is an internal matter with no need for external demonstration
Christian witness is optional and secondary to doctrine
questions.correctAnswer: Youthful believers must be examples in all aspects of faith and conduct
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12 exhorts Timothy not to let anyone despise his youth but to be an example in word, conversation, charity, spirit, faith, and purity, linking personal holiness with redemptive witness.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses 1 Timothy 4:3 and 1 Timothy 4:4 teach about Christian liberty and creation?
options: God’s creation is good and believers may rightly enjoy it with thanksgiving
All created things are inherently sinful and should be avoided
Legalistic abstinence from marriage and meats is required for holiness
Divine approval is only for asceticism and self-denial
questions.correctAnswer: God’s creation is good and believers may rightly enjoy it with thanksgiving
questions.explanation: Verses 4 and 3 together affirm that every creature of God is good and nothing is to be refused if received with thanksgiving, opposing forbidding marriage and abstaining from meats.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Timothy 4:6 and 1 Timothy 4:14 teach about ministerial responsibility?
options: Ministers must remind brethren of sound doctrine and steward their spiritual gifts faithfully
Ministers are not responsible for teaching doctrine but only for administration
Spiritual gifts are optional for ministry effectiveness
Remembrance of doctrine is unnecessary for mature believers
questions.correctAnswer: Ministers must remind brethren of sound doctrine and steward their spiritual gifts faithfully
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:6 urges Timothy to remind brethren of sound doctrine, and 4:14 warns not to neglect the gift given by prophecy with laying on of hands, highlighting faithful stewardship of teaching and gifts.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 Timothy 4:7 and 1 Timothy 4:8 teach about godliness and human effort?
options: Godliness is profitable and should be pursued over profane fables and mere bodily exercise
Physical exercise is equally profitable as godliness for eternal life
Old wives’ fables are necessary for spiritual growth
Godliness is less important than adherence to cultural traditions
questions.correctAnswer: Godliness is profitable and should be pursued over profane fables and mere bodily exercise
questions.explanation: Verses 7-8 contrast rejecting profane fables and prioritizing godliness, which profits in this life and the life to come, over bodily exercise which profits little.

questions.question: Skeptics claim that 1 Timothy 4:3-5 promotes licentiousness by allowing all foods. What does 1 Timothy 4:3-5 actually teach?
options: God created all foods to be received with thanksgiving and sanctified by God’s word and prayer
All foods are allowed without any moral or spiritual consideration
Believers should eat whatever they want without restraint
Food restrictions are a human invention with no divine authority
questions.correctAnswer: God created all foods to be received with thanksgiving and sanctified by God’s word and prayer
questions.explanation: Verses 3-5 clarify that forbidding marriage and abstaining from foods contradicts God’s design, and that foods are sanctified by the word and prayer, indicating a controlled liberty not licentiousness.

questions.question: What doctrine about ministry does 1 Timothy 4:11 teach?
options: Ministers are commanded to teach and command these doctrinal points
Ministers should avoid doctrinal teaching and focus only on pastoral care
Doctrinal instruction is optional for church leaders
Ministers must prioritize political influence over teaching
questions.correctAnswer: Ministers are commanded to teach and command these doctrinal points
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:11 explicitly commands Timothy to command and teach these things, emphasizing the minister’s role in doctrinal instruction.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is implied by 1 Timothy 4:14 concerning spiritual gifts?
options: Providence in sovereignly distributing gifts through prophecy and laying on of hands
Omnipotence in miraculously granting gifts independently of human agency
questions.correctAnswer: Providence in sovereignly distributing gifts through prophecy and laying on of hands
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:14 describes the gift given by prophecy and laying on of hands of the presbytery, showing God's providential distribution of spiritual gifts through the church.

questions.question: What theological synthesis arises from 1 Timothy 4:12 and 1 Timothy 4:15 regarding Christian growth?
options: Believers, regardless of age, must be examples and meditate wholly to show spiritual progress
Spiritual growth is automatic with age and requires no effort
Meditation is irrelevant to Christian example and witness
Only elders should be examples of faith and charity
questions.correctAnswer: Believers, regardless of age, must be examples and meditate wholly to show spiritual progress
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:12 calls for being an example in all areas, and 4:15 urges meditation and full devotion so that progress may be evident to all, combining personal holiness with visible growth.

questions.question: How does 1 Timothy 4:13 prepare the church for sound teaching?
options: By urging attention to reading, exhortation, and doctrine until Paul’s arrival
By discouraging public reading and doctrinal instruction
By prioritizing only personal prayer over communal teaching
By promoting silence and discouraging exhortation
questions.correctAnswer: By urging attention to reading, exhortation, and doctrine until Paul’s arrival
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 4:13 exhorts Timothy to give attendance to reading, exhortation, and doctrine, preparing the church for sound teaching in Paul’s absence.
